name: Terminal block
purpose: A macOS-styled terminal card. Appears twice on the site in two measurably different dressings.

chat.note: the Home Benefits card variant — grey #f6f6f6 titlebar with a text label, three rgb(215,214,212) dots, body rows at 15px/24px in the body face

install.note: the Developers explorer variant — translucent white 20px header with three near-black dots and a Copy action, body a fixed 80px with a GT Standard Mono prompt glyph
install.bodyHeightNote: The body is pinned at 80px on every tab deliberately: the longest command wraps to two lines and the shorter ones leave line two empty. Letting it size to content made it snap 80->60px per switch, which read as a jerk.
